digest.component_or_area: documentation: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md git workflow guide
propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED commit, when it actually accepts any commit reachable from HEAD with a rebar-ticket trailer or matching subject, regardless of merge status.
The precheck is conditional on file_impact being recorded and completion-verification gate being enabled, but the documentation presents it as unconditional.

AGENTS.md omits documentation of rebar transition --ref, which is the sanctioned way to close a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree, and is already documented in transition.txt and plan-review-gate.md.
The land-before-close ordering rule is the Verified +1 policy (AGENTS.md:233-234), not the precheck mechanism; misattributing it to the precheck leads agents to skip --ref when closing stacked work.
The precheck scans git log against current HEAD with no ref argument, so --ref retargets verification and signature but does not narrow the referencing-commit scan.
The NEVER-fast-forward-the-shared-main-checkout warning must be preserved verbatim in both files, while the fast-forward recipe is repositioned as remedy only for worktrees lacking the commit.
